note: The lower bound is on the active-price index set, so the all-frozen vacuity and identity padding for inactive links are not separate Lean steps; the bound is eventual in x with eta depending on the patch and teller.

theorem not_flat (G : Gauge) (P : Patch) (Pt : Teller G) (hS : P.Branches Pt.bind G) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ {c f : Side} (S : StepData c f) (T : Tube G S),
    S.patch=P → 100*(1+radiusB x) ≤ c.val → Pt.Funds S T →
    ∀ (A : Stores S) (F : Forest S.ratio) (k:S.Choices) (V : Config G c), A.flags=RG.flags (temp x) V →
    ∀ a : Prices G (Active A x F), η*(a ⬝ᵥ a) ≤ a ⬝ᵥ (Rows.gram T x V k (shots S x) A F *ᵥ a) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For large `x`, on all active prices `η*(a ⬝ᵥ a) ≤ a ⬝ᵥ (Rows.gram ... *ᵥ a)`.

def Trust (G : Gauge) (p : Teller G) (P : Patch) (x C r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (σ η : ℝ) :=
  ∀ {c f : Side} (S : StepData c f) (T : Tube G S), S.patch=P → p.Funds S T →
    100*(1+radiusB x) ≤ c.val → ∀ (V : Config G c) (t:S.Choices) (A : Stores S) (F : Forest S.ratio),
      A.flags=RG.flags (temp x) V → ∀ B : Directions G c, ‖B‖ ≤ r →
        let g := front (G:=G) A F (x:=x); let H := pilot T A F t x V;
        RatesPaid (down S) g σ C k (scroll T A F t x V) B ∧
          RatesPaid g g σ C k H B ∧ Gapped (H B) η ∧ (H B).PosDef ∧
          (∀ z, z ⬝ᵥ (H B *ᵥ z) ≤ C * sumSq z) ∧
          ∀ (i : Bond c) (s : Signed), curb (shots S x) A F x s (.inr i) →
            ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun y => G.mat (Press.workQ V s t i y)) (B,0)

proof_context.conclusion: `Trust` records `Gapped (H B) η` and `PosDef` for the pilot matrix `H B`.
